name: L23-retry1
delta:
SEED ROLES. The FIRST image is the in-chain parent scene — preserve its held set and existing composition. The SECOND image is the crowd exemplar — use only its anonymous crowd proportion and face tier. The THIRD image is the `lettering-marker-italic` environment reference — preserve its authored place facts.

The same lamp-lit warehouse: shoulder-high pallets of sealed brown cartons receding toward the shut roller door, the film drawn hard round the lower courses and cut back clear of the whole unwrapped top row, the crew of packers at the far pallet, the tally card carrying '26,000' against the front pallet. Only this changes: the front carton on that unwrapped top row now stands with its flaps folded open. That carton is ONE OF THE RANKED CARTONS ITS PARENT ALREADY DREW and it keeps EXACTLY THAT CARTON'S SIZE: it is the same small width, height and depth as every other sealed carton in the same top row, roughly one third of that pallet's width, and its folded-open flaps stay within that same small footprint. It does NOT grow to the width of the pallet, it does NOT replace or swallow the rest of the top row, and it does NOT overlap the neighbouring pallets, which keep their own ranked cartons. Inside it lies one red clay brick on crumpled paper, and that brick FILLS THE CARTON EXACTLY: the brick spans the carton's opening corner to corner, its edges nearly touching the carton walls on all four sides, so the brick is plainly the same size as the box that holds it and only a little crumpled paper shows at the margins. Everything else exactly as established.
